programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E01 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 1, World Strongest Viking
programme.desc: This year 14 athletes from all over the world came to Fefor to compete in 6 cruel events. We'll see typical Viking disciplines on very heavy conditions in land of snow and ice, World records and athletes like the title defender Krzysztof Radzikowski, strongest guys from Holland and Germany and many more

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E02 SCL S6 Ep2 FIBO Power
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capita in the World and of course, the most powerful host in Strongman champions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2019 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E03 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 3, Turkey
programme.desc: On a spectacular beach in Alanya, the MLO Strongman Champions League Turkey was viewed by thousands of spectators over a two day battle. With 12 athletes at the start over 6 cruel events, like Marble Stone Lift, Truckpull and Deadlift cars. And with the comeback of Travis Ortmayer / USA, former stone king and world ranked competitor. Winner of several SCL stages in the past.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E04 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 4, Holland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Four times Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter competing here in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, and 3 in this episode: The first event, a truckpull of 17.000 kg over 25 meters in max 75 seconds, was a real hard pull Also for the World Champion Truckpull, Holland’s runner-up Kelvin de Ruiter, but watch his amazing technique here.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E05 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 5, Holland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter, competing in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, 3 in this second episode; a Viking-press of 150 kg with the current world record holder Luke Herrick. The fifth event, a front hold of 25 kg is loved or hated by the athletes and lastly, the Stones of Strength.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E06 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 6, Russia
programme.desc: An unbelievable TANK PULL of 50.000 kg was at the stage of SCL RUSSIA. Never seen this before! Not only a tank pull was done here but also the Viking Press/ Deadlift Max and Log lift reps were spectacular events to see here in Russia. With Mikhail Koklyaev also as event presenter, the former top 3 world strongest man from Russia was there

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E07 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 7, Serbia
programme.desc: In this year’s edition on The Balkan Peninsula, we have competing the new talent from Estonia Marko Remlik together with Sebastian Kurek from Poland and yellow leader Kelvin de Ruiter

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E08 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 8, Finland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland and Aivars Smaukstelis from Latvia are the strongman future of these days. Mateusz is the best man in the World at the moment to defeat. Only 25 years and such a fantastic strongman. They come here only for a win. But there are 12 more Strong athletes in this episode who want the title of Finland as well.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E09 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 9, Finland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Mateusz Is leading after day 1 (previous episode) with close behind him Aivars Smaukstelis and Zake Muluzi from the UK. All very exciting! 5 events in this episode: Log Lift, Fram Walk, Deadlift, Sack Throw (Weight for Height), Loading medley.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E10 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 10, Portugal
programme.desc: In this stage we have a new strong debutant: Oleg Sylka from the Ukraine. He is the new talent, who will stand up against the old champions like ZSydrunas Savickas and Brian Shaw and the Stoltman Brother from the UK. This new talent Oleg is a great character and we will see him flame in the episode in Portugal.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E11 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 11, Callio
programme.desc: In Callio is the deepest mine of Europe/ 1500 meter deep, whereas the MLO Strongman Champions League also did 1 event. The Forward Hold, on a 1500 dept/ also a kind of new record/ as it was never done before. Spectacular and new in Strongman sport.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E12 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 12, Ukraine
programme.desc: Kelvin de Ruiter is here to defend his SCL World Truck Pull Championships title. But this year, another strong field wants his title. Over 3 different pulls with 3 different trucks, and 14 athletes at the start, it will be difficult for everybody.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E13 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 13, Caribbean
programme.desc: SCL edition Curacao 2019 was a great event, twelve power boys from all over made a great show at the white beaches, and 35 degrees Celsius heat in the Carrabean Islands. Two events were held on Friday at the beach of beautiful resort Sunscape, the other three were held near the world famous floating bridge at Willemstad on Saturday night.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E14 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 14, Dubai
programme.desc: Hosted at Meydan Grandstand in Dubai, the Strongman Champions League had some really big names in the list like Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland, Brian Shaw from the USA and Krzysztof Radzikowski. In front of the Burj Khalifa the athletes do the deadlift max and 4 other heavy events at another spot in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E15 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 15, World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. The last stage over 2 episodes of the MLO Strongman Champions League, were held in Porto, Portugal. This competition in Portugal is full of memorable performances and strong results.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E16 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 16, World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. This competition in Portugal is full of memorable performances and strong results and this is the final!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E01 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 1, Norway
programme.desc: The spectacular Fefor Arena hosted for the 8th time the Worlds Strongest Viking, part of the SCL World Series. But with the absence of former title holders its anyones game. Again, a very spectacular episode of the Strongman Champions League here in Norway.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E02 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 2, Finland (Part 1)
programme.desc: In this episode, the Titan, former double World champion from Latvia will compete against his fellow countryman and the current World champion - Aivars Smaukstelis. With 8 events over 2 stages the contestants are pushed to their limits in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E03 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 3, Finland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Dainis Zageris and Aivars Smaukstelis, both from Latvia have a serious, strong battle in the this second and final episode of the SCL Finland 2020. Watch the unbelievable and brute power of these athletes in the last 4 events to crown the winner.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E04 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 4, World Record Breakers
programme.desc: The SCL Germany event takes place in an ancient castle called Die Burg in the heart of Germany. Its here where 5 world record attempts take place across 5 different events with 10 athletes. They will go to the max! See this and much more in the SCL Germany 2020.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E05 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 5, Strongest Viking
programme.desc: SCL Norway is normally all about snow, wind, and cold weather. Our brave athletes are used to compete under conditions few other athletes have competed in, but after COVID delays the competition has been moved from winter to summer bringing in a whole new range of challenges. With an impressive athlete list who will be the winner across 5 cruel events?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E06 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 6, World Strongest Team 1
programme.desc: Were in sunny Finland for the next stage of a double-bill of SCL action, but this time its a team event. A truly fantastic event with 6000 spectators. Even during COVID times this was exceptional! 8 Strong Teams where fighting for the title over a crazy 9 events.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E07 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 7, World Strongest Team 2
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland, done over 9 cruel events. In this episode the last and final 5 events take place. 8 Strong Teams are fighting for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E08 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 8, Portugal
programme.desc: The next set of challenges are set in sunny Esposende in Portugal. With stars such as Travis Ortmayer, Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland, and Ervin Toots from Estonia. While Fabio Silva will defend the honour in his own country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E09 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 9, World Records (Part 1)
programme.desc: We are back in Germany, with the world record breakers. We promise you this is going to be amazing. Do not move from that seat, because we are going to see some records smashed today. Over 6 cruel events, you will see who gets crowned of the King Of The Castle!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E10 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 10, World Records (Part 2)
programme.desc: With the next episode of Strongman Champions League Germany. Its the world record breakers, and in the last show we set two new records. Can more be records be broken before the king of the castle is crowned?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E11 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 11, Worlds 105 Kg (Part 1)
programme.desc: Welcome to Kokkola in Finland. This city will be the setting for the Lightweight World championship. Out of 24 athletes, only 16 will make it through to the final day, but who will champion each event and who is going to be eliminated?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E12 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 12, Worlds 105 Kg (Part 2)
programme.desc: Its the second day, and the top 16 athletes have made it through to the final round. With another 4 events to go who will get the crown of world champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E13 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 13, Ukraine
programme.desc: Welcome to Ukraine and the wonderful capital city of Kyiv. Were here for the second time for the iconic truck pull World Championships! The reigning World champion Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland will defend his title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E14 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 14, Romania
programme.desc: In this episode, a final chance for our athletes to get vital world series ranking points on board to give them the best possible chance of success and an initial advantage at the finals. It's the last show before the world finals and the top 10 places are up for grabs, but who will they be?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E15 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 15, World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Here in the sunshine, well finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is - you could not ask for a better setting. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E16 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 16, World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E01 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 1, Finland Stage 1
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E02 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 2, Holland Part 1
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E03 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 3, Holland Part 2
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E04 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 4, Serbia Part 1
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E05 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 5, Serbia Part 2
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E06 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 6, Joensuu Part 1
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E07 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 7, Joensuu Part 2
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E08 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 8, Esposende
programme.desc: Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We’re in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. With a real Porsche deadlift and many other crazy stuff. So, lets get this show started.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E09 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 9, Great Britain
programme.desc: Hello and welcome in Gloucester, UK. The world tour hasn’t been here for what feels like forever. And now for the first time in the Mekka of Strongman, the SCL World series will crown a great Champion with the SCL Title. It will be full with special wooden events, and a great winner! So ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, brace yourselves because I present to you strongman champions league UK.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E10 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 10, Poland Part 1
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland the home of Legends Mariusz Pudzianowkski and Krzystof Radzikowski. Who will grab the title here in holiday resort Sopot, on the great Balrtic Sea with 6 events and 12 athlets in the mix!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E11 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 11, Poland Part 2
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland, after 3 events the Polish Strongman Oskar Ziolkowski is Leading. Kelvin, Travis and Aivars are coming up and will try to beat him, but will Oskar take his first title ever?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E12 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 12, Bosnia
programme.desc: it’s been a long time since the world series held a championship here in Sarajevo. Let’s see what test of strength this destination holds for our athletes. And what fantastic athletes are here again in Stage 12 of the SCL World Series. The strongman champions league Bosnia is another iconic Strongman event with the return of Rongo Keen from Australia and Portugal winner 2022 George Sulaiman.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E13 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 13, Romania
programme.desc: Welcome to Sibiu in Romania. It’s an important day for some of these athletes, because four of them have a real chance of getting into our all-exclusive world finals. There’s only one more stage after this to get those all-important extra points. So, there’s going to be some fireworks, who will take the title here and who will qualify for the World Finals?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E14 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 14, Gibraltar
programme.desc: This is it the last show before the world final. These guys have really got to fight for the points now, this is going to be action packed, whilst these guys fight it out all day.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E15 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 15, Turkey Part 1
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkey’s south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season of Strongman Champions League. Here in the sunshine, we’ll finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is. You could not ask for a better setting. After months of hard-work, if not years for some of these lads, we find out who will take the world title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E16 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 16, Turkey Part 1
programme.desc: Welcome, to day two of the strongman champions league 2022 finals here in Alanya, Turkey. It’s all up for grabs now, everyone is fighting for the world title belt. This is an epic episode where we finally crown the World champion of 2022.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E01 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 1 - Finland
programme.desc: Welcome to the 2023 Strongman Champions League in Vaasa, Finland! This year’s event introduces a knockout format with 6 intense events over 90 minutes, ending in a unique deadlift face-off with boats.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E02 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 2 - Serbia
programme.desc: Stage 2 of the Strongman Champions League 2023 is set in Zrenjanin, Serbia. This exciting event features 5 challenging contests, including a superhuman Yoke race. As the SCL World Series Tour continues, athletes will battle it out to claim the yellow leader’s position for the season. Don’t miss this incredible stage of strength and endurance!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E03 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 3 - Finland Teams World
programme.desc: The World’s Strongest Team will be crowned in this edition of SCL, here in Kalajoki-Finland we’ve picked some of the best in the business, teamed them up, and they’ll be going all out against each other. It’s now no longer about being a lonely wolf, but more about the pack mentality. It is a competition over 7 events, including a Big 2-man Log lift and heavy deadlift. Let’s start the action.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E04 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 4 - Holland
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League in Holland at the Dru Factory in ULFT. A great location for a spectacular battle with 14 Athletes over 3 events! The first 3 events in this episode are Truckpull/ Superyoke and Farmerswalk, with 2 massive logs of 150 kg in their hands. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it’s the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E05 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 5 - Holland 2023
programme.desc: Ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, strongman fans across the world, we are back for SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it’s about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland, continues with the last 3 events, here at the Dru Factory in ULFT. The events in this episode are the Viking Press, Wheel Flip and the Atlas Stones, with 180 kg in the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E06 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 6 - World's Strongest Latino
programme.desc: For the first time ever, the World’s Strongest Latino competition has begun. This two-day event in Porto, Portugal, features 20 athletes from around the world competing in 8 events. After 4 grueling events, the top 12 will advance to the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E07 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 7 - Finland World Record Breakers
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League World Record Breakers 2023 starts with a 25-ton snow plow! Crazy machines are pulled and pushed, with many kilograms moved. A few new world records are set in this competition.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E08 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 8 - Portugal
programme.desc: We have returned to the powerhouse of Portugal for an edge-of-your-seat galactic battle. If all the planets collided at once, it wouldn’t compare to the bang of this show. Get ready for the battle of the beasts; it’s the heaviest show in the universe, the Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E09 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 9 - England
programme.desc: SCL UK has landed in Gloucester it is workout war fitness for the ferocious, it’s going to be a a battle of the brutal, a rampage of the roofless. This is going to be a massacre of the muscles. You know it by now, but just in case you don’t, this is strongman champions league.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E10 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 10 - World's Strongest Viking
programme.desc: On the menu this week it’s medieval madness, we’ve come back to the middle ages to test our noble men through a muscle gaining of events. They are hoping and we are hoping that one will survive to take the title of the world’s strongest Viking. The official World's Strongest Viking is this time in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This week is a good one, can you feel the energy? Sit still, just look at me and try and feel the energy, because I can tell you, the atmosphere here is electric, it’s explosive, there is a pure elemental force going through these athletes' veins. I’m shaking because it’s Poland, it’s powerful, it’s strongman champions league, and you know what I'm going to say, get ready because it’s about to get heavy.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Poland part 2 - Who will win the title in Poland and take 25 points for the world ranking. It is very exciting on the top, in part 1 between Poland and Latvia. Another great episode with super strongman events such as: Bag Toss Medley, Log Lift Reps and the Powerstairs. Also an interview with Mateusz Kieloszkowski, the all time favorite champion from Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: It’s time to show our strength and gain respect from the gods of Olympus. Our gladiators have many events set out by no other than Hercules himself. The coliseum is ready here on this mythological island of Cyprus, so we have landed in Limassol were again 12 Top Strongmen are battling for the title and ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E14 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 14 - South Africa
programme.desc: The only and official world championship Truckpulling for its 10th year, again at the Strongman Champions league. With the 3 times Worldchampion Kelvin de Ruiter – defending his title. This championship has trucks in all shapes and sizes which is a lot like our athletes, there all different pay loads, but does the biggest win or is it the strongest.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E15 Stage 15 - SCL World Finals Bosnia
programme.desc: Years and years of determination has brought us here today, when all the walls felt like they were caving in perseverance. When their bodies were screaming, hurting, shouting stop, beneath. These are the things which make up a man, these are the things that bring you world finalists. This episode they fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E16 Stage 16 - SCL World Finals Bosnia
programme.desc: Part 2 of the World Finals of the Strongman Champions League tour 2023 at the Sarajevo Centar Skenderija in Bosnia. 3 Events was done already and amazing results have been set. Who will be the new World champion? Find out here, who, after 16 stages, will be crowned World Champion 2023.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 10 years there is another edition of THE ICEMAN in minus 25 degrees and snow, and it is also the first stage in the MLO Strongman Champions League. With a new World champion from South Africa, Rayno Nel, it will be a challenging year for all the athletes to win the title again after 1 full year. But now they can win one very exceptional title, which is the SCL ICEMAN!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A battle in the beautiful Caribbean Islands. Over 2 days and more than 10,000 spectators expected like previous editions. The cold temperature from the Iceman is changed in 35 degrees hot Martinique. Watch who gets the title in Martinique, events include: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Hercules Hold, Log Lift, and Arm Over Arm Pull.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL Hungary this year is in the AQUAPARK in Budapest, Stage 3 from the spectacular MLO Strongman Champions League, World is Biggest Pro League. With five great events, such as: Viking Press, Farmer's Walk, Deadlift, Conan's Wheel, and A loading race with Beer barrels of 200 Kg. It is a must see!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We're in Zrenjanin, Serbia, again a fantastic stage in the SCL WORLD SERIES TOUR 2024, five events including a super human Yoke race. Who will be the yellow leader for the coming season and take the title with 25 championship points?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We're in Groenlo, east of Holland With the new Talent from South Africa and 2025 Strongest Man of the World - Rayno Nel. The first 3 events are Truckpull, Log Lift and Loading race. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it is the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it is about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland , continues with the last 3 events, here at the venue in Groenlo. The events in this episode are the Conan Wheel, Farmers Walk and the Atlas Stones, with a brutal 200kg stone at the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S10 : E07 Stage 7 - FINLAND - 2024 - World record breakers
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League: World Record Breakers 2024 kicks off with the Truck Pull, followed by the Front Hold, Frame Carry, Tractor Pull, Shield Carry, Sandbag Toss, and concludes with the intense Loading Race. This two-day competition features all the top strongmen from Finland-and it's one for the history books. Three new world records are shattered, making this a must-see episode for...

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time in over 10 years back in Estonia, in Tartu. 12 of the Strongest athletes in the world will fight here for the title and the overall world championship points. You will see 5 crazy events, such as: Boat Pull, Viking Press, Medley, Conan's Wheel and a very heavy Power Stairs!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We have returned to Portugal, at the beach of Eposende, to bring you EUROPE'S STRONGEST LATINO. In the beautiful sun of Portugal five cruel events are done in this heat: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Log Lift, Sandbag Toss, Medley.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A spectacular event on the beach of Gdansk, Poland. A competition in the sand and in the water. Complete with a boat pull. With an impressive line up again, we welcome you to watch us LIVE in the SCL Poland.

programme.title: Kwestie van Centen
programme.desc: 'Hogere kilometervergoeding oplossing voor dure benzine? Veel werkgevers betalen helemaal niks'Vakbond CNV wil graag met het kabinet en werkgevers om tafel om een sociaal akkoord te sluiten, maar de AOW kan meteen van de agenda gehaald. Volgens de nieuwe voorzitter Hans van den Heuvel is er geen enkel probleem met de AOW-leeftijd. 'Het kabinet moet zich gewoon aan het pensioenakkoord houden.' In Kwestie van Centen bespreekt hij met Martin Visser de economische en politieke actualiteit. De belofte van werkgevers dat ze meer kilometervergoeding gaan betalen vanwege de dure brandstof wantrouwt hij: 'Nu krijgt 12 procent van de werknemers nog helemaal geen vergoeding. Begin daar eerst eens mee.'

Natuurlijk gaat het over het vertrek van Dennis te Kloese bij Feyenoord. De directeur verlaat Feyenoord, wie staat er in de coulisse om hem op te volgen op algemeen gebied en technisch vlak? En wat betekent dit voor de positie van de getergde trainer Robin van Persie? Verder: de buitenlandse trips van meerdere clubs zijn een doorn in het oog van Valentijn, Simonis gaat aan de slag als trainer bij Sparta en haalt Matthijs de Ligt het WK?

programme.title: Het Land van Wierd Duk
programme.desc: 'Geef Nederland het zelfbewustzijn van de Argentijnen'Op het WK-voetbal laat het Argentijnse elftal zien hoe onverschrokken en strijdvaardig een gemeenschap kan zijn die eensgezind optreedt, zegt Wierd Duk in een nieuwe aflevering van de podcast Het Land van Wierd Duk. ,,Die vanzelfsprekende liefde voor het vaderland is in veel Europese landen nagenoeg verdwenen. Zeker ook in Nederland.” In Friesland vind je wél veel terug van die gemeenschapszin. Duk: ,,Nederland heeft meer Friesland nodig.” Verder in de podcast: de hoogoplopende discussie over late abortus. En: JD Vance, Amerika en de crisis rond Iran.

programme.title: Kwestie van Centen
programme.desc: 'Hogere kilometervergoeding oplossing voor dure benzine? Veel werkgevers betalen helemaal niks'Vakbond CNV wil graag met het kabinet en werkgevers om tafel om een sociaal akkoord te sluiten, maar de AOW kan meteen van de agenda gehaald. Volgens de nieuwe voorzitter Hans van den Heuvel is er geen enkel probleem met de AOW-leeftijd. 'Het kabinet moet zich gewoon aan het pensioenakkoord houden.' In Kwestie van Centen bespreekt hij met Martin Visser de economische en politieke actualiteit. De belofte van werkgevers dat ze meer kilometervergoeding gaan betalen vanwege de dure brandstof wantrouwt hij: 'Nu krijgt 12 procent van de werknemers nog helemaal geen vergoeding. Begin daar eerst eens mee.'

programme.title: Homefront
programme.desc: Voormalig narcotica-agent Phil Broker denkt een rustiger leven te krijgen nu hij zich met zijn dochtertje in een plattelandsstadje heeft gevestigd. Het Amerikaanse zuiden blijkt echter nogal licht ontvlambaar.

programme.title: Jackie
programme.desc: De 33-jarige tweeling Sofie en Daan is opgevoed door twee vaders. Wanneer er totaal onverwacht een telefoontje van hun, tot dan toe onbekende, biologische moeder uit Amerika komt, storten ze zich in een avontuur waardoor alle aannames die ze hadden op losse schroeven komen te staan.

programme.title: Wild Mountain Thyme
programme.desc: Al haar hele leven is de koppige Rosemary verliefd op haar verlegen buurman Anthony. Hij weet zich echter geen raad met haar gevoelens. Daarbij heeft hij zijn handen vol aan zijn eigenwijze vader Tony, die hun boerderij wil verkopen aan zijn succesvolle Amerikaanse neef Adam.

programme.title: Rookie
programme.desc: ROOKIE volgt het verhaal van Nicky, een jonge ambitieuze en zelfverzekerde motorrijder pur sang. Elke race zet hij zijn leven op het spel, niet voor geld maar voor de kicks, het respect en de roem. Zijn wereld stort onverwachts in wanneer hij door een ongeval nooit meer zal kunnen racen...

programme.title: Sharing Relations
programme.desc: Scott heeft weinig gemaakt van zijn leven. Hij gebruikt drugs, heeft geen baan en is volledig vervreemd van zijn familie. Uiteindelijk besluit hij het contact met zijn broer William en zijn zieke vader te herstellen. Eén probleem: William is inmiddels getrouwd met Scotts ex-vriendin Katherine.

programme.title: Oorlogswinter
programme.desc: Oorlogswinter is het verhaal van Michiel die in de laatste ijskoude winter van de oorlog volwassen wordt. Zijn Oom Ben, die in het verzet zit, is zijn grote voorbeeld en Michiel kan niet wachten tot hij ook wat kan betekenen in de strijd tegen de bezetter.

programme.title: Meet Dave
programme.desc: Een groep kleine mensachtige buitenaardse wezens arriveert op aarde in een ruimteschip dat erg veel lijkt op hun eigen kapitein. De besturing van het ruimteschip levert in de omgang met mensen nogal wat misverstanden op…

programme.title: Dik Trom - De Vetste Film
programme.desc: Dik Trom is een vrolijke, eerlijke, maar vooral gezette jongen. Samen met zijn ouders woont hij in het knusse Dikkedam, waar iedereen net zo dik en uitbundig is als hij. Het is er elke dag feest.

programme.title: Weg Van Jou
programme.desc: Romcom die draait om de stadse Evi (Herbers). Met frisse tegenzin wordt ze door haar werkgever van hip Rotterdam overgeplaatst naar stil Zeeuws-Vlaanderen. Dat het niet allemaal onverstaanbare Zeeuwen zijn, blijkt als Evi in Terneuzen de stoere visser Stijn (Heijmans) ontmoet.

programme.title: The Trials of Cate McCall
programme.desc: Een voormalig vooraanstaande advocate heeft te kampen met een alcoholverslaving en is erdoor totaal vervreemd geraakt van haar familie. Ze wil zich, na een schorsing voor dit alcoholprobleem, rehabiliteren op haar werk en de voogdij herwinnen over haar dochter.

programme.title: Seized
programme.desc: De zoon van een voormalig geheim agent wordt ontvoerd en hij moet nu drie gevaarlijke misdaadorganisaties uitschakelen als hij zijn zoon ooit nog levend terug wilt zien.

programme.title: Setup
programme.desc: Sonny, Vincent en Dave bereiden zich voor op een gevaarlijke overval op een diamanthandelaar. Nadat de klus met succes is geklaard, opent Vincent het vuur op zijn partners. Dave komt om het leven, maar Sonny leeft nog en hij is vastberaden om Vincent terug te pakken!

programme.title: Willy's Wonderland
programme.desc: Een rondreizende man (Nicolas Cage) wordt misleid tot het aannemen van een baantje als conciërge in het verlaten pretpark Willy’s Wonderland...

programme.title: Homefront
programme.desc: Voormalig narcotica-agent Phil Broker denkt een rustiger leven te krijgen nu hij zich met zijn dochtertje in een plattelandsstadje heeft gevestigd. Het Amerikaanse zuiden blijkt echter nogal licht ontvlambaar.

programme.title: Emperor
programme.desc: Terwijl hij zich een weg naar het noorden vecht om zichzelf en zijn familie te bevrijden, bundelt de bandiet-slaaf Shields "Emperor" Green zijn krachten met abolitionist John Brown voor een gewaagde aanval op Harpers Ferry, West Virginia, in 1859.

programme.title: Sharing Relations
programme.desc: Scott heeft weinig gemaakt van zijn leven. Hij gebruikt drugs, heeft geen baan en is volledig vervreemd van zijn familie. Uiteindelijk besluit hij het contact met zijn broer William en zijn zieke vader te herstellen. Eén probleem: William is inmiddels getrouwd met Scotts ex-vriendin Katherine.

programme.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
programme.desc: Samen met mevrouw Fox, zoon Ash, neefje Kristofferson en al hun vrienden beleeft meneer Fox een avontuur om zijn familie te beschermen. Een grappig en betoverend verhaal voor het hele gezin!

programme.title: Wild Mountain Thyme
programme.desc: Al haar hele leven is de koppige Rosemary verliefd op haar verlegen buurman Anthony. Hij weet zich echter geen raad met haar gevoelens. Daarbij heeft hij zijn handen vol aan zijn eigenwijze vader Tony, die hun boerderij wil verkopen aan zijn succesvolle Amerikaanse neef Adam.

programme.title: Made in America
programme.desc: Een verhaal over het vinden van je familie, zelfs als die familie niet is wat je verwacht.

programme.title: Date Movie
programme.desc: Julia Jones weet eindelijk de man van haar dromen aan de haak weet te slaan, maar nu wordt haar perfecte bruiloft bedreigd door haar ex, een schetenlatende kat en excentrieke schoonfamilie.

programme.title: Rookie
programme.desc: ROOKIE volgt het verhaal van Nicky, een jonge ambitieuze en zelfverzekerde motorrijder pur sang. Elke race zet hij zijn leven op het spel, niet voor geld maar voor de kicks, het respect en de roem. Zijn wereld stort onverwachts in wanneer hij door een ongeval nooit meer zal kunnen racen...

programme.title: Armour of God - Chinese Zodiac
programme.desc: Meesterdief en schatzoeker Asian Hawk krijgt de opdracht van zijn leven. Tijdens de Opiumoorlogen werden 12 bronzen beelden van de Chinese dierenriem gestolen en over de hele wereld verspreid. De opdracht luidt: opsporen en terugbrengen naar het Zomerpaleis in Peking.

programme.title: Loosies
programme.desc: Bobby, een zakkenroller uit New York, wordt geconfronteerd door een vrouw waar hij een onenightstand mee heeft gehad. Wanneer Lucy hem vertelt dat ze zwanger is, moet hij de realiteit onder ogen zien. Plotseling botsen twee verschillende werelden, waardoor Bobby zijn leven opnieuw moet evalueren.

programme.title: Bedazzled
programme.desc: De naïeve computertechnicus Elliot wordt het slachtoffer van een sexy duivelin. Hij verkoopt zijn ziel in ruil voor zeven wensen, in de hoop dat zijn mooie collega verliefd op hem wordt.

programme.title: Cloud Atlas
programme.desc: Cloud Atlas vertelt zes verhalen die zich in een verschillende tijd en op verschillende plaatsen afspelen en onlosmakelijk met elkaar verbonden zijn. Het eerste verhaal speelt zich rond 1850 af, terwijl het laatste verhaal zich honderden jaren in de toekomst afspeelt.

programme.title: Primal
programme.desc: In de keiharde actiefilm Primal is jager Frank Walsh (Nicolas Cage) gespecialiseerd in het vangen van wilde dieren. Zijn laatste indrukwekkende vangst bestaat onder meer uit 'The Ghost Cat', een zeldzame witte jaguar...

programme.title: Undisputed 4
programme.desc: In het vierde deel van deze bikkelharde actiefilm franchise, beproeft Boyka (Scott Adkins) zijn geluk in de professionele Europese competitie. Wanneer een van zijn tegenstanders het gevecht met de dood moet bekopen, beseft Boyka dat hij niet alleen voor de titel maar ook voor zijn leven vecht.

programme.title: Vanguard - Elite Special Force
programme.desc: Tang Huanting (Jackie Chan) is de oprichter van Vanguard; de beste en meest gerespecteerde beveiligingsagency, met klanten over de hele wereld. Als de Chinese zakenman Qin Guoli in Londen wordt ontvoerd door militanten uit het Midden-Oosten komen de Vanguard leden direct in actie.

programme.title: Sharing Relations
programme.desc: Scott heeft weinig gemaakt van zijn leven. Hij gebruikt drugs, heeft geen baan en is volledig vervreemd van zijn familie. Uiteindelijk besluit hij het contact met zijn broer William en zijn zieke vader te herstellen. Eén probleem: William is inmiddels getrouwd met Scotts ex-vriendin Katherine.

programme.title: Pushing Tin
programme.desc: Nick Falzone is de nummer één luchtverkeersleider totdat een stille vreemdeling, Russell Bell, wordt overgeplaatst naar de afdeling. De rivaliteit tussen de twee beste luchtverkeersleiders op New York TRACON escaleert tot een potentieel gevaarlijk niveau.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: Wanneer een bijdehante zwarte oplichter uit Zuid-Centraal LA wordt teruggevoerd naar het middeleeuwse Engeland, leidt hij de omverwerping van een kwaadaardige koning en wint hij het hart van een protofeministische vrouw.

programme.title: Sommersby
programme.desc: Men herinnert zich Jack Sommersby. Men kent hem als een verbitterde, ruwe man. Maar wanneer Jack na de Burgeroorlog terug naar huis komt is hijteder, liefdevol en vindingrijk.

programme.title: Date Movie
programme.desc: Julia Jones weet eindelijk de man van haar dromen aan de haak weet te slaan, maar nu wordt haar perfecte bruiloft bedreigd door haar ex, een schetenlatende kat en excentrieke schoonfamilie.

programme.title: Seized
programme.desc: De zoon van een voormalig geheim agent wordt ontvoerd en hij moet nu drie gevaarlijke misdaadorganisaties uitschakelen als hij zijn zoon ooit nog levend terug wilt zien.

programme.title: Adios Amigos
programme.desc: Drie vrienden met een handicap (Yannick van de Velde, Martijn Lakemeier en Bas Hoeflaak) willen net als iedere andere jonge twintiger wel eens met iemand naar bed. Eén van hen weet dat de meisjes in Salou altijd gewillig zijn, dus dan moeten ze daar maar heen.

programme.title: Armour of God - Chinese Zodiac
programme.desc: Meesterdief en schatzoeker Asian Hawk krijgt de opdracht van zijn leven. Tijdens de Opiumoorlogen werden 12 bronzen beelden van de Chinese dierenriem gestolen en over de hele wereld verspreid. De opdracht luidt: opsporen en terugbrengen naar het Zomerpaleis in Peking.

programme.title: Knock Knock
programme.desc: Evan Webber (Keanu Reeves) is architect en woont met zijn lieve vrouw en twee jonge kinderen in een mooi huis in Californië. Als zijn gezin een weekendje naar het strand gaat, blijft hij thuis werken. Het regent, hij is alleen en luistert naar muziek als op de deur wordt geklopt.

programme.title: Hard Kill
programme.desc: Het werk van tech-ontwikkelaar en miljardair Donovan Chalmers is zo kostbaar dat hij een team huurlingen onder leiding van Derek Miller in dienst heeft ter bescherming. Wanneer een terroristische groepering zijn tech in handen krijgt en zijn dochter Eva kidnapt...

programme.title: Ninja - Shadow of a Tear
programme.desc: De Amerikaanse martial arts meester Casey Bowman (Scott Adkins) is neergestreken op de Koga Ninja dojo in Japan en getrouwd met Namiko Takeda (Mika Hijii), die zwanger is van hun eerste kind.

programme.title: Raped in Custody
programme.desc: Investigate claims that some American law enforcement officers used their positions of power to assault women.

programme.title: Rondje WK
programme.desc: In Rondje WK praat de VI-redactie je dagelijks bij over alles rond het Wereldkampioenschap voetbal. Vanuit Nederland bespreken de journalisten het laatste nieuws, opvallende momenten, tactische keuzes en de prestaties van Oranje en de andere toplanden. Met analyses, meningen en een flinke dosis voetbalpassie blijf je tijdens het WK helemaal op de hoogte.

programme.title: VI ZSM
programme.desc: VI ZSM is je snelle update van de dag — korte, scherpe content gemaakt door VI-journalisten. Van actualiteit tot opvallende verhalen: in enkele minuten ben je weer helemaal bij. Voor wie geen tijd heeft om achter te blijven.

programme.title: Extra tijd
programme.desc: Extra Tijd is het verzamelblok voor de echte voetballiefhebber. Verwacht een gevarieerde mix van recente samenvattingen, legendarische wedstrijden, iconische interviews en originele VI-content. Of het nu gaat om nieuws, nostalgie of scherpe analyses — in Extra Tijd komt alles samen. Perfect voor wie nooit genoeg krijgt van Nederlands voetbal.

programme.title: Wild Moments
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Dangerous and Deadly I
programme.desc: Wildlife film-makers often risk life and limb trying to capture unique images of their dangerous protagonists.

programme.title: Wild Moments
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Dangerous and Deadly II
programme.desc: Follow wildlife-filmmakers on their adventurous journeys throughout the world.

programme.title: Green China Rising
programme.desc: In the war to save our planet's future, the battleground is China.

programme.title: Europe's Secret Eden: Polesia
programme.desc: Olya Kaskevich is dedicated to saving Polesia , Europe’s largest wetland wilderness

programme.title: Food, Funk, Favela
programme.desc: Witness the dedicated fight against hunger and food wastage, and the empowerment of vulnerable communities in Brazil's most resilient communities.

programme.title: A Lens on the World
programme.desc: Incredible photography has a power. It can inspire or incite, delight or disgust. It can provoke action. And, as history has shown us, it can even change the world.

programme.title: AI Rangers
programme.desc: South Africa is one of the last strongholds of the rhino. Rangers are facing a war where they must use every trick up their sleeve – and one man has developed a high-tech Artificial Intelligence solution to stop poachers in their tracks.

programme.title: A Forest Worth Fighting For
programme.desc: Tucked away on the border of Poland and Belarus lies an old-growth forest with a unique diversity of fungi, invertebrates and a cradle of the rebirth of European bison.

programme.title: A Meatless Future
programme.desc: This punchy short film is about tackling our relationship with meat consumption.

programme.title: Last of My Kind
programme.desc: One hundred and sixty species have become extinct over the past decade, and the rate of loss is increasing rapidly. FaithInvest’s Martin Palmer leads a service to mourn them.

programme.title: It's Not All Black And White
programme.desc: When it comes to fighting against poaching, it’s not always the most obvious approaches that have the biggest impact.

programme.title: 1.5 Degrees of Confusion
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 You vs Your Boss - Making my Workplace Climate Conscious
programme.desc: You’re doing your bit at home to reduce your carbon emissions but, once you get to work, it feels like climate action is at the bottom of everyone’s to-do list. So in this episode, we’re taking on the tricky topic of speaking to your boss about climate change.

programme.title: Growing Back Beirut
programme.desc: Eco Architect Adib Dada and the 'guerrilla foresters’ trying to bring green spaces back to Beirut - Beirut’s Riverless Forest.

programme.title: Every Living Thing
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Save the Whales Again
programme.desc: The INTERNATIONAL MONETARY FUND values earth’s whale fleet at over $1 trillion. To find out why, enjoy a deep breath and dive into the most beautiful fecal fuelled love triangle on the planet. Meet the cast of whales who safeguard the seas for us all.

programme.title: Every Living Thing
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Bees - Plight of the Pollinator
programme.desc: Until flowers grow legs or learn Tinder, they’ll need bees and other pollinators to make ‘it’ happen. One of the most important species on the planet, find out what you can do to help bees - help us - avoid a future without food.

programme.title: Every Living Thing
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Jaguars - Guardians of Reality
programme.desc: Amazonian apex predator and true American hero. Three million years in the making but now on the verge of breaking. Their penchant for predation holds the key to rewilding tropical ecosystems. Learn why these natural born healers deserve our respect.

programme.title: Every Living Thing
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Wolves - Born to Rewild
programme.desc: Wolves. So often the fall guy in myths modern and ancient. Usually cast as the murdering, thieving, molesting type - there’s more to these loveable rogues than meets the mind’s eye. Discover why those we feared for so long could help save us.

programme.title: Not a Pet
programme.desc: Every year hundreds of cheetah cubs are stolen from the wild, decimating the dwindling population of Africa's most endangered big cat. For every five cubs that are taken, only one survives. They are then smuggled into the Middle East to be sold as an exotic pet.

programme.title: Not a Pet
programme.desc: Tigers might be the most endangered big cat in the world, but they are a common sight in captivity, often exploited for petting opportunities, circuses, or kept as exotic pets to flaunt as status symbols.

programme.title: Not a Pet
programme.desc: Live reptiles and amphibians are hugely popular amongst collectors; the rarer the species, the more valuable it is in the exotic pet trade. But many of the animals found in this trade have in fact come from the wild, causing many populations to be pushed towards extinction.

programme.title: Other Ways of Living
programme.desc: Go on a journey to explore how we can design, build and live in more circular homes and cities.

programme.title: Other Ways of Living
programme.desc: How can we start rethinking our relationship with clothes? Take a look at some remarkable innovations happening in the world of fashion.

programme.title: 1.5 Degrees of Confusion
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Carbon Neutral vs Net Zero - What's the difference?
programme.desc: When it comes to climate jargon, Carbon Neutral and Net Zero are two terms that seem to pop up everywhere.

programme.title: Other Ways of Living
programme.desc: Discover how some people are redesigning food so that nature can thrive, using methods of food production that are regenerative rather than destructive for the environment.

programme.title: Behind the Scenes of Circularity
programme.desc: In the first episode of this circular economy series we meet Steven, the clothing connoisseur who’s spent the last thirty years proving why used clothes are anything but useless.

programme.title: Behind the Scenes of Circularity
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 The Great British Bean Brokers
programme.desc: In the second episode of this circular economy series we meet Nick and Josiah, the food aficionados who believe that, when it comes to the future of farming, you can’t beat a bean!

programme.title: Behind the Scenes of Circularity
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 The Re-Use Role Model
programme.desc: In the third and final episode of this circular economy series we meet Safia, a packaging provocateur who’s trying to wipe out waste, one cup at a time!

programme.title: ReDress The Future
programme.desc: The first episode in this series will focus on the first pillar of circular and sustainable fashion; buying fewer new clothes.

programme.title: ReDress The Future
programme.desc: Focusing on the forward-thinking fashionistas who are using waste products to make some of fashion’s most sought after pieces.

programme.title: ReDress The Future
programme.desc: Looking to the future of responsible, circular fashion and investigate the latest technology in recycled textiles.

programme.title: Primates
programme.desc: Not A Pet looks at the illegal wildlife pet trade, and the role social media plays in the parading and trading of exotic animals online. This episode focuses on great apes and monkeys.

programme.title: Mother of the Sea
programme.desc: This short film tells the legend of The Mother of the Sea.

programme.title: Ocean Greens
programme.desc: Ocean Greens is an intimate portrait of farmers harvesting seaweed along the UK’s coastlines.

programme.title: Martha’s Delta
programme.desc: Meet Martha Agbani, a spirited activist who has dedicated her life to restoring the mangrove ecosystem in the Niger Delta.

programme.title: One Chew at a Time

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yugo and Yuri being their duel, with Zarc's shared influence forcing them into battle. To stop Zarc's revival, Kaito and Edo join the battle as well to hold back Yuri's powerful Fusion Dragon.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: While Yuri and Yugo continue their savage battle, Reira starts hearing the voice of Ray. Aiming to make sure Ray is revived, Reira stands against Reiji and the siblings begin a duel with each other.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Reiji manages to defeat Reira, continuing on to fight Leo. Elsewhere, Yuri absorbs Yugo and aims to defeat Yuya so that Zarc can be completed. Yusho stands in for his son to fight the depraved youth instead.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yusho's advanced Dueltaining manages to push Yuri into a corner and bring Yuya back to his old self. But Yuri is determined to complete Zarc's revival and has one nasty surprise in store for Yusho.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Seeing his father carded in front of his eyes, Yuya's rage reaches a boiling point as he accepts Yuri's challenge. But not only does he have to contend with Yugo and Yuri's dragons, but Zarc's ever growing influence over him.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The four dimensions start to fuse together as Yuya continues to struggle against Yuri. Forced to discard his trump card, things seem hopeless. Yuya's friends then arrive to encourage him to keep fighting no matter what.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.sub-title: S03 : E136 A Most Brutal Duel
programme.desc: Yuya absorbs all of his counterparts and reclaimed his true form as Supreme King Z-ARC. Starting to lay waste to the Fusion Dimension, Sora and Edo challenge Zarc to try and reach out to Yuya's spirit.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The four dimensions continue to unite as Zarc effortlessly crushes Sora and Edo. Kaito and Shun continue the fight against Zarc while people from Heartland and Neo Domino City start appearing in the Fusion Dimension.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Gongenzaka and Jack fight against Zarc next, trying their best to reach out to Yuya's soul buried in Zarc's darkness. A revived Crow and Sawatari decide to join in when Zarc's Supreme King Dragons swarm the field.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Crow notices that Zarc is starting to lose his composure, leading him and Sawatari to up their game against Zarc's dragons. As dimensional integration is getting closer to completion, Reiji tries to convince his dad to stop Zarc.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.sub-title: S03 : E140 A Ray of Hope
programme.desc: Ray's soul possesses Reira so she can battle against Zarc alongside Reiji. Zarc boasts that he is the creator of Pendulum Summon, but Ray is determined to stop him once and for all using the four natural energy cards.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.sub-title: S03 : E141 Swinging Back into Action
programme.desc: Things have seemingly returned to normal in the Pendulum Dimension, but Yuya gets the feeling that something is missing. Reiji has him duel against Tsukikage to restore his memories and make him finish the Lancer's goal for good.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The battle royale continues. As Yuya keeps fighting, his memories start flooding back to him. Yuzu's dad suddenly remembers too as the rest of the world slowly begins to remember the Lancers and the battle against Zarc.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Reiji reveals that Zarc is still alive and Reira is barely holding back his malevolence. The world must be united and Yuya must purge Zarc's evil once and for all. Yuya is unsure. but Gongenzaka attempts to ignite his fighting spirit.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya arrives in the Xyz Dimensions with Dennis as his next opponent. Threatening to turn the traumatized citizens of Heartland into cards again, Dennis forces Yuya into a duel against him and his Xyz/Fusion mix.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya arrives in the Fusion Dimension where he finds a distraught Shun. Like with Yuya's counterparts, Ruri and the others have not been resurrected following Ray's revival. Yuya tries to calm Shun down only to end up the target of his fury.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.sub-title: S03 : E146 One Way Street to Defeat
programme.desc: Jack appears to taunt Yuya over his fear of using his counterpart's dragons in fear of summoning Zarc. Unable to accomplish anything as is, Yuya challenges Jack to a duel while Reiji makes it so everyone can watch the battle.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya finally listens to his other selves and summons all four of his dragons to defeat Jack. However, there is one final challenge before him in order to become a Dueltainer and purge Zarc: his rival and friend Reiji Akaba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The curtain is about to fall for the last time. The final battle between Yuya and Reiji rages on. Dragons face off against D/D/D as the whole world watches. What will be the final fate of Yuya, Yuzu, and all four dueling dimensions?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Go With the Flow - Part 1
programme.desc: In Heartland, Yuma Tsukumo aspires to be the world's best Duelist. Despite this, he is not a good Duelist. When he ends up Dueling, Shark, a student known to have pro-level skills, odd things begin to happen and Yuma's story begins.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Go With the Flow - Part 2
programme.desc: The Duel between Yuma and Ryoga comes to its conclusion. In order to take down "Leviathan Dragon", Yuma obtains a "Number" monster of his own, "Utopia".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 In the End - Part 1
programme.desc: Astral's been unable to leave since Yuma Dueled Shark, so, despite his reluctance, he's begun living with Yuma. At an inconvenient time, Akari Tsukumo has trouble when her PC she uses as a stay-at-home reporter crashes. When her big scoop is deleted as a result of a system down the city suffered, she orders Yuma to find an alternate scoop she can use for another manuscript. When Yuma goes into town, the traffic lights go nuts, causing downtown to fall into chaos. Yuma looks for the criminal who spread the computer virus that caused all this chaos.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 In the End - Part 2
programme.desc: Yuma challenges Professor Kitano, who is behind it all. Professor Kitano notes that each time he reduces his opponent's Life Points with "Electronic Computer-Beast Tera Byte" Astral's body weakens, causing him to slowly vanish! To make things worse, the Explosive Virus Time Bomb Ukyo has set is slowly reaching its countdown.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: A strange shadow approaches Yuma, which turns out to be Tokunosuke Omoteura, a classmate of Yuma's known for his duplicitous tongue. In the morning, Yuma was reprimanded for a prank he pulled in front of the whole class that he has no memory of causing. As a result, he's been cut off from every one else. Tokunosuke gently says "Let's Duel". With "Baby Tragon" his new Xyz Monster, Yuma might enjoy this duel, but Tokunosuke seems to be planning something.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Tokunosuke steals Yuma's "Utopia", causing Astral to vanish. Tokunosuke wanted the great power of Numbers, and Yuma tries to Summon "Leviathan Dragon" to fight back, but Tokunosuke's Trap Card takes even that away. When Yuma is pushed into a corner with his field, an unexpected monster will become the Trump Card of the Duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: After having been around a while and having to work with Yuma, Astral's been fascinated by a TV Show Hero named "Different Dimension ESPer Robin". For some reason, Astral feels close and similar to this Robin from an alternate universe. One day, pictures show up with Robin in a fight downtown! Yuma, prodded by Astral, goes with Kotori to where the autographs were taken and meets Robin's actor, a kid named Fuya! But Fuya is a timid boy who doesn't resemble the Robin they all admire in the slightest.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The mysterious person posing as Robin around town was Fuya. Under the intolerable strain of being a hero, Fuya's heart has been overcome by darkness Yuma challenges him to a Duel to save his soul. Robin, however, possesses "Number 83: Galaxy Queen". With it, he proceeds to summon one character after another from the TV Show. At first, Yuma and Astral were amused by this, but due to Galaxy Queen's almighty Monster Effect, they quickly grow impatient. To make things worse, Galaxy Queen, who currently possesses Robin, has taken on the appearance of Fuya's mother.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: A suspicious shadow is trailing Yuma. It seems someone has been after Yuma, and their identity is the unassuming girl Cat-chan from Yuma's class. Yuma and Kotori fall into Cat-chan's trap. To rescue Kotori, he's going to have to Duel. Astral is cautious of the strange vibes he's getting from Cat-chan, especially with the strategy of her "Transforming Cat Deck"!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma is reminded that his victories in his current Duels are due to Astral's help. To prove his skills, he fights Shark once more. Though Shark doesn't care to Duel again, he finally agrees when he finally reaches the end of his rope due to Yuma's constant following him around. The Duel of these two begins. programme.title: A King and His Queen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E36 A King and His Queen S1 E36
programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.sub-title: S03 : E05 Jodha Akbar S3 E5
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: A King and His Queen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E38 A King and His Queen S1 E38
programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.sub-title: S03 : E09 Jodha Akbar S3 E9
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.
